cards.question: Что такое анатомия?
cards.reference: Наука о форме и строении тела человека и животных; делится на макро- и микроскопическую.

cards.question: Сагittal plane?
cards.reference: Сагittalная плоскость делит тело на правую и левую части.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Frontal (coronal) plane?
cards.reference: Фронтальная плоскость делит тело на переднюю и заднюю части.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Transverse plane?
cards.reference: Поперечная (горизонтальная) плоскость делит тело на верхнюю и нижнюю части.

cards.question: Что означает cranial / superior?
cards.reference: К голове, выше (верхнее положение).
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Caudal / inferior?
cards.reference: К хвосту/ногам, ниже.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Anterior / ventral?
cards.reference: Передняя (ventral — животная сторона).

cards.question: Posterior / dorsal?
cards.reference: Задняя (dorsal — спинная сторона).
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Medial vs lateral?
cards.reference: Medial — ближе к срединной линии; lateral — дальше от неё.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Proximal vs distal?
cards.reference: Proximal — ближе к туловищу; distal — дальше от туловища (для конечностей).

cards.question: Superficial vs deep?
cards.reference: Поверхностный vs глубокий слой.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Что такое анатомическое положение?
cards.reference: Стандартная поза: стоя, ладони вперёд, большие пальцы наружу.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Terms of movement: flexion?
cards.reference: Сгибание — уменьшение угла в суставе.

cards.question: Extension?
cards.reference: Разгибание — увеличение угла в суставе.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Abduction / adduction?
cards.reference: Отведение от срединной линии / приведение к ней.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Rotation?
cards.reference: Вращение вокруг продольной оси кости или органа.

cards.question: Что такое fascia?
cards.reference: Соединительнотканная оболочка, окружающая мышцы и органы.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Сerosa / adventitia?
cards.reference: Сerosa — у органов в полостях; adventitia — у органов вне полостей.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Organ Systems I

cards.question: Что такое visceral vs parietal?
cards.reference: Visceral — покрывает орган; parietal — выстилает стенку полости.

cards.question: Homeostasis в контексте анатомии?
cards.reference: Согласованная работа систем для стабильности внутренней среды.
cards.image_alt: Терминология и основы: Regions of Human Body

cards.question: Сколько костей у взрослого человека?
cards.reference: Около 206 (вариабельно — сесамовидные, слияния).

cards.question: Диафиз и эпифиз?
cards.reference: Диафиз — ствол кости; эпифиз — концевые части с суставными поверхностями.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Костный мозг?
cards.reference: В полостях костей (красный — кроветворение, жёлтый — жир).

cards.question: Типы костей по форме?
cards.reference: Длинные, короткие, плоские, нерегулярные, сесамовидные.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Синдесмоз / симфиз / синостоз?
cards.reference: Сочленение соединительной тканью / хрящом / костью.

cards.question: Synovial joint components?
cards.reference: Суставная полость, синовиальная жидкость, суставной хрящ, кapsula.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Ball-and-socket joint пример?
cards.reference: Плечевой и тазобедренный суставы.

cards.question: Hinge joint пример?
cards.reference: Локтевой, коленный.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Pivot joint?
cards.reference: Атланто-аксиальный (C1–C2) — вращение головы.

cards.question: Axial skeleton?
cards.reference: Череп, позвоночник, грудная клетка.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Appendicular skeleton?
cards.reference: Кости плечевого пояса, свободные конечности, таз.

cards.question: Clavicle и scapula?
cards.reference: Ключица и лопатка — пояс верхней конечности.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Pelvis?
cards.reference: Подвздошные, седалищные, лобковые кости + крестец.

cards.question: Fontanelles?
cards.reference: «Мягкие точки» черепа новорождённого до окостенения.
cards.image_alt: Опорно-двигательная: 603 Anatomy of a Long Bone

cards.question: Osteoblast / osteoclast?
cards.reference: Клетки формирования / резорбции костной ткани.

cards.question: Типы мышечной тissue?
cards.reference: Поперечнополосатая (скелетная), гладкая, сердечная.

cards.question: Origin vs insertion?
cards.reference: Начало (проксимальнее, обычно неподвижнее) vs место прикрепления (движется).

cards.question: Agonist / antagonist?
cards.reference: Мышца, выполняющая движение / противодействующая ему.

cards.question: Synergist?
cards.reference: Помогает agonist, стабилизирует сустав.

cards.question: Fascicle arrangements?
cards.reference: Параллельные, круговые, одноперистые, двуперистые, многоперистые.

cards.question: Tendon?
cards.reference: Плотное сухожилие — прикрепление мышцы к кости.

cards.question: Aponeurosis?
cards.reference: Широкое плоское сухожильное листовидное прикрепление.

cards.question: Motor unit?
cards.reference: Мотонейрон + все иннервируемые им мышечные волокна.

cards.question: Что такое sarcomere?
cards.reference: Функциональная единица поперечнополосатой мышцы между Z-линиями.

cards.question: Actin и myosin?
cards.reference: Белки, обеспечивающие скольжение и сокращение.

cards.question: Isometric vs isotonic?
cards.reference: Сокращение без изменения длины / с укорочением.

cards.question: Slow-twitch vs fast-twitch fibers?
cards.reference: Type I (выносливость) vs Type II (сила, скорость).

cards.question: Что такое motor end plate?
cards.reference: Нервно-мышечное соединение — синапс на мышечном волокне.

cards.question: Delayed onset muscle soreness?
cards.reference: DOMS — микроповреждения после непривычной нагрузки.

cards.question: Rotator cuff?
cards.reference: Группа мышц стабилизирующих плечевой сустав (supraspinatus и др.).

cards.question: Камеры сердца?
cards.reference: Правое и левое предсердия; правый и левый желудочки.

cards.question: Клапаны сердца?
cards.reference: Трicuspid, mitral (bicuspid), pulmonary, aortic.
cards.image_alt: Сердечно-сосудистая: 2005 Surface Anatomy of the Heart

cards.question: Systole / diastole?
cards.reference: Систола — сокращение; диастола — расслабление/наполнение.

cards.question: Малый круг кровообращения?
cards.reference: Правый желудочек → лёгочная артерия → лёгкие → лёгочные veins → левое предсердие.

cards.question: Большой круг?
cards.reference: Левый желудочек → аорта → органы → vena cava → правое предсердие.
cards.image_alt: Сердечно-сосудистая: 2005 Surface Anatomy of the Heart

cards.question: Arteries vs veins?
cards.reference: Артерии несут кровь от сердца (обычно богаты кислородом в большом круге); veins — к сердцу.

cards.question: Что такое capillaries?
cards.reference: Капилляры — обмен газов и питательных веществ с тканями.

cards.question: Sinoatrial node?
cards.reference: SA-узел — «пейсмeker» сердца в правом предсердии.
cards.image_alt: Сердечно-сосудистая: 2005 Surface Anatomy of the Heart

cards.question: AV node и bundle of His?
cards.reference: Проведение импульса предсердия → желудочки.

cards.question: Coronary circulation?
cards.reference: Коронарные артерии питают миокард.

cards.question: Blood pressure systolic/diastolic?
cards.reference: Давление при систоле / диастоле.
cards.image_alt: Сердечно-сосудистая: 2005 Surface Anatomy of the Heart

cards.question: Что такое stroke volume?
cards.reference: Объём крови, выбрасываемый желудочком за одно сокращение.

cards.question: Atherosclerosis?
cards.reference: Отложение бляшек в артериях — риск ишемии.

cards.question: Lymph return role?
cards.reference: Часть жидкости возвращается через лимфатическую систему в вены.
cards.image_alt: Сердечно-сосудистая: 2005 Surface Anatomy of the Heart

cards.question: Portal circulation?
cards.reference: Портальная система печени — вена из ЖКТ → печень → vena cava.

cards.question: Upper vs lower respiratory tract?
cards.reference: Верхние: нос, глотка, гортань; нижние: трахея, бронхи, лёгкие.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Alveoli function?
cards.reference: Газообмен: O₂ и CO₂ через alveolar-capillary membrane.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Diaphragm role?
cards.reference: Главная мышца вдоха — опускается, увеличивая объём грудной полости.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: External intercostals?
cards.reference: Поднимают рёбра при вдохе.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Pleura?
cards.reference: Visceral и parietal pleura с pleural cavity и fluid.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Conducting vs respiratory zone?
cards.reference: Проведение воздуха без газообмена vs зона alveoli.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Surfactant?
cards.reference: Снижает surface tension в alveoli — предотвращает collapse.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Vital capacity?
cards.reference: Максимальный объём выдоха после максимального вдоха.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Anatomical dead space?
cards.reference: Объём дыхательных путей без участия в газообмене.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Carina?
cards.reference: Разветвление трахеи на главные bronchi.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Larynx и vocal cords?
cards.reference: Гортань — голосовые связки, защита трахеи при глотании.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Epiglottis?
cards.reference: Закрывает glottis при глотании.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Bronchi vs bronchioles?
cards.reference: Проводящие пути с хрящом → без хряща, с smooth muscle.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Mediastinum?
cards.reference: Средостение — сердце, крупные сосуды, трахея, пищевод.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Cough reflex anatomy?
cards.reference: Раздражение receptors в airways → expiratory muscles.
cards.image_alt: Дыхательная: 2312 Gross Anatomy of the Lungs

cards.question: Oral cavity role?
cards.reference: Механическая обработка, salivary amylase, bolus formation.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Esophagus?
cards.reference: Перistalsis доставляет пищу в stomach.

cards.question: Stomach regions?
cards.reference: Cardia, fundus, body, pylorus; gastric mucosa, glands.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Small intestine parts?
cards.reference: Duodenum, jejunum, ileum — основное всасывание.

cards.question: Large intestine?
cards.reference: Cecum, colon, rectum — вода, electrolytes, microbiota.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Liver lobes?
cards.reference: Печень — detox, bile production; left/right lobes, caudate, quadrate.

cards.question: Gallbladder?
cards.reference: Хранение и концентрация bile.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Pancreas exocrine/endocrine?
cards.reference: Digestive enzymes (exocrine) + insulin/glucagon (islets of Langerhans).

cards.question: Villi и microvilli?
cards.reference: Увеличивают surface area тонкой кишки.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Hepatic portal vein?
cards.reference: Кровь из ЖКТ → печень перед systemic circulation.

cards.question: Sphincter of Oddi?
cards.reference: Кontrol bile/pancreatic juice entry в duodenum.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Appendix?
cards.reference: Придаток cecum — lymphoid tissue.

cards.question: Greater omentum?
cards.reference: Жировая «фартук»-складка — защита и immmune role.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Mesentery?
cards.reference: Прикрепление intestines к posterior abdominal wall.

cards.question: Peristalsis mechanism?
cards.reference: Coordinated smooth muscle contraction waves.
cards.image_alt: Пищеварительная: 2401 Components of the Digestive System

cards.question: Kidney structure?
cards.reference: Cortex, medulla, renal pyramids, pelvis.

cards.question: Nephron?
cards.reference: Функциональная единица: glomerulus + tubules (PCT, loop of Henle, DCT).

cards.question: Glomerular filtration?
cards.reference: Фильтрация plasma в Bowman's capsule.

cards.question: Ureter, bladder, urethra?
cards.reference: Проведение и хранение urine до выведения.

cards.question: Detrusor muscle?
cards.reference: Мышца стенки мочевого пузыря.

cards.question: Internal vs external urethral sphincter?
cards.reference: Involuntary smooth vs voluntary skeletal (perineum).

cards.question: Renal artery/vein?
cards.reference: Кровоснабжение почки (~20% cardiac output).

cards.question: ADH effect on kidney?
cards.reference: Увеличивает reabsorption воды в collecting ducts.

cards.question: Aldosterone?
cards.reference: Reabsorption Na⁺ в distal nephron.

cards.question: Juxtaglomerular apparatus?
cards.reference: Regulation renin release.

cards.question: Micturition reflex?
cards.reference: Bladder stretch → parasympathetic contraction; voluntary control external sphincter.

cards.question: Renal calyces?
cards.reference: Collect urine from pyramids into pelvis.

cards.question: Countercurrent multiplier?
cards.reference: Loop of Henle concentrates urine in medulla.

cards.question: Prostate (male)?
cards.reference: Surrounds urethra — secretions in semen.

cards.question: Female urethra length?
cards.reference: Короче — выше риск UTI.

cards.question: CNS vs PNS?
cards.reference: Central (brain, spinal cord) vs peripheral nerves, ganglia.

cards.question: Neuron parts?
cards.reference: Soma, dendrites, axon, synaptic terminals.

cards.question: Myelin?
cards.reference: Schwann cells (PNS) / oligodendrocytes (CNS) — saltatory conduction.

cards.question: Synapse?
cards.reference: Presynaptic neuron → synaptic cleft → postsynaptic neuron.

cards.question: Grey vs white matter?
cards.reference: Grey — cell bodies; white — myelinated tracts.

cards.question: Spinal cord cross-section?
cards.reference: Grey H-shape (horns), white columns, central canal.

cards.question: Dorsal root vs ventral root?
cards.reference: Sensory afferent vs motor efferent.

cards.question: Reflex arc?
cards.reference: Receptor → sensory neuron → interneuron → motor neuron → effector.

cards.question: Autonomic sympathetic vs parasympathetic?
cards.reference: Fight-or-flight vs rest-and-digest.

cards.question: Cranial nerves count?
cards.reference: 12 пар (I–XII) — olfactory, optic, oculomotor, …).

cards.question: Blood-brain barrier?
cards.reference: Tight junctions capillaries CNS — selective permeability.

cards.question: CSF circulation?
cards.reference: Choroid plexus → ventricles → subarachnoid space → absorption.

cards.question: Meninges layers?
cards.reference: Dura, arachnoid, pia mater.

cards.question: Ganglion?
cards.reference: Cluster of neuron cell bodies in PNS.

cards.question: Tract vs nerve?
cards.reference: CNS bundle of axons vs PNS bundle.

cards.question: Endocrine vs exocrine?
cards.reference: Hormones в blood vs ducts наружу.

cards.question: Hypothalamus-pituitary axis?
cards.reference: Hypothalamus releasing hormones → anterior pituitary.

cards.question: Thyroid hormones?
cards.reference: T3/T4 — metabolism regulation; iodine needed.

cards.question: Parathyroid?
cards.reference: PTH — calcium homeostasis с костями и kidneys.

cards.question: Adrenal cortex zones?
cards.reference: Mineralocorticoids (aldosterone), glucocorticoids (cortisol), androgens.

cards.question: Adrenal medulla?
cards.reference: Epinephrine/norepinephrine — sympathetic response.

cards.question: Pancreatic islets?
cards.reference: Insulin (beta), glucagon (alpha).

cards.question: Pineal gland?
cards.reference: Melatonin — circadian rhythm.

cards.question: Negative feedback?
cards.reference: Hormone уровень подавляет дальнейшую секрецию.

cards.question: Target cell receptors?
cards.reference: Cell-surface или intracellular (steroid hormones).

cards.question: Growth hormone source?
cards.reference: Anterior pituitary — somatotrophs.

cards.question: Oxytocin / ADH storage?
cards.reference: Posterior pituitary releases hormones made in hypothalamus.

cards.question: Thymus role?
cards.reference: T-cell maturation ( prominent in children).

cards.question: Gonads endocrine?
cards.reference: Testosterone / estrogen-progesterone.

cards.question: Diabetes types anatomy link?
cards.reference: Type 1 — beta cell destruction; type 2 — insulin resistance.

cards.question: Eye layers?
cards.reference: Fibrous (sclera/cornea), vascular (choroid/ciliary/iris), retina.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Cornea vs lens?
cards.reference: Cornea — фиксированная преломляющая поверхность; lens — accommodation.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Retina photoreceptors?
cards.reference: Rods (dim light) vs cones (color, detail).
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Fovea centralis?
cards.reference: Центральная ямка — максимальная acuity.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Optic nerve?
cards.reference: CN II — axons ganglion cells → brain.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Ear outer/middle/inner?
cards.reference: Pinna/ canal; ossicles; cochlea/vestibule.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Tympanic membrane?
cards.reference: Eardrum — vibration to ossicles.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Cochlea function?
cards.reference: Organ of Corti — hearing transduction.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Semicircular canals?
cards.reference: Balance — rotational acceleration.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Taste buds location?
cards.reference: Papillae tongue primarily; also soft palate, pharynx.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Olfactory epithelium?
cards.reference: Upper nasal cavity — smell receptors.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Lacrimal apparatus?
cards.reference: Tear production and drainage.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Extraocular muscles?
cards.reference: Six muscles move each eye (CN III, IV, VI).
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Pupillary reflex?
cards.reference: Light → CN II → midbrain → CN III constriction.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1404 The Structures of the Ear

cards.question: Presbyopia?
cards.reference: Age-related lens stiffening — loss accommodation.
cards.image_alt: Органы чувств: 1413 Structure of the Eye

cards.question: Skin layers?
cards.reference: Epidermis, dermis, hypodermis (subcutaneous).

cards.question: Epidermis strata?
cards.reference: Stratum corneum → basale (keratinocytes).

cards.question: Melanocytes?
cards.reference: Melanin production — UV protection.

cards.question: Dermis components?
cards.reference: Collagen, elastin, blood vessels, nerves, appendages.

cards.question: Hair follicle?
cards.reference: Epithelial root sheath, dermal papilla, arrector pili.

cards.question: Sebaceous glands?
cards.reference: Sebum — lubrication skin/hair.

cards.question: Eccrine vs apocrine sweat?
cards.reference: Thermoregulation widespread vs body odor areas.

cards.question: Nails structure?
cards.reference: Nail plate, matrix, bed, lunula.

cards.question: Pacinian corpuscles?
cards.reference: Deep pressure/vibration mechanoreceptors in dermis.

cards.question: Free nerve endings?
cards.reference: Pain and temperature.

cards.question: Barrier function?
cards.reference: Prevents water loss and pathogen entry.

cards.question: Vitamin D synthesis?
cards.reference: UV in epidermis converts cholesterol derivatives.

cards.question: Blister anatomy?
cards.reference: Separation epidermis from dermis — fluid-filled.

cards.question: Burn degrees?
cards.reference: 1st epidermis; 2nd partial dermis; 3rd full thickness.

cards.question: Skin graft?
cards.reference: Transplant epidermis/dermis for wound coverage.

cards.question: Lymph composition?
cards.reference: Interstitial fluid, lymphocytes, proteins returned to blood.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Lymph capillaries?
cards.reference: Highly permeable — pick up excess tissue fluid.

cards.question: Lymph nodes function?
cards.reference: Filter lymph, immune activation (B/T cells).
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Major lymph node groups?
cards.reference: Cervical, axillary, inguinal, mesenteric.

cards.question: Thoracic duct?
cards.reference: Largest lymph vessel — drains most body into left subclavian vein.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Right lymphatic duct?
cards.reference: Drains right upper quadrant.

cards.question: Spleen functions?
cards.reference: Blood filtration, immune response, platelet storage.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Tonsils?
cards.reference: Mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue — first defense pathogens.

cards.question: Peyer's patches?
cards.reference: Lymphoid follicles in ileum.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Lymphatic vs blood capillaries?
cards.reference: One-way valves, no RBC, blind-ended.

cards.question: Edema cause?
cards.reference: Excess interstitial fluid when lymph/blood flow impaired.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Lymphedema?
cards.reference: Chronic swelling from lymph obstruction.

cards.question: Macrophages in nodes?
cards.reference: Phagocytose pathogens and debris.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Adaptive immunity in nodes?
cards.reference: Antigen presentation to lymphocytes.

cards.question: Lymphatic role in fat absorption?
cards.reference: Lacteals in villi transport chylomicrons.
cards.image_alt: Лимфатическая: 2201 Anatomy of the Lymphatic System

cards.question: Testes structure?
cards.reference: Seminiferous tubules — spermatogenesis; interstitial Leydig cells — testosterone.

cards.question: Epididymis / vas deferens?
cards.reference: Sperm maturation and transport.

cards.question: Prostate, seminal vesicles?
cards.reference: Accessory glands — seminal fluid components.

cards.question: Penis erectile tissue?
cards.reference: Corpora cavernosa and spongiosum.

cards.question: Ovaries?
cards.reference: Oogenesis, estrogen/progesterone production.

cards.question: Uterine tubes (fallopian)?
cards.reference: Fertilization site; cilia move ovum.

cards.question: Uterus layers?
cards.reference: Endometrium, myometrium, perimetrium.

cards.question: Menstrual cycle anatomy?
cards.reference: Endometrial proliferation and shedding.

cards.question: Placenta?
cards.reference: Fetal-maternal exchange organ.

cards.question: Breast (mammary) anatomy?
cards.reference: Glandular lobules, ducts, adipose; lactiferous sinuses.

cards.question: Puberty changes?
cards.reference: Secondary sex characteristics via gonadal hormones.

cards.question: Scrotum thermoregulation?
cards.reference: Maintains optimal testicular temperature.

cards.question: Cervix?
cards.reference: Lower uterus — canal between uterus and vagina.

cards.question: Broad ligament?
cards.reference: Supports uterus and tubes in pelvis.

cards.question: External genitalia homologues?
cards.reference: Embryologic origin paired structures male/female.

cards.question: Brain major regions?
cards.reference: Cerebrum, cerebellum, brainstem (midbrain, pons, medulla).

cards.question: Cerebral lobes?
cards.reference: Frontal, parietal, temporal, occipital.

cards.question: Primary motor cortex?
cards.reference: Precentral gyrus — voluntary movement.

cards.question: Somatosensory cortex?
cards.reference: Postcentral gyrus — touch, pain, temperature.

cards.question: Visual cortex?
cards.reference: Occipital lobe — primary visual area.

cards.question: Broca vs Wernicke areas?
cards.reference: Speech production (frontal) vs comprehension (temporal).

cards.question: Basal ganglia?
cards.reference: Caudate, putamen, globus pallidus — motor control.

cards.question: Thalamus?
cards.reference: Relay sensory/motor signals to cortex.

cards.question: Hypothalamus functions?
cards.reference: Homeostasis: temperature, hunger, hormones, circadian.

cards.question: Hippocampus?
cards.reference: Memory formation and spatial navigation.

cards.question: Amygdala?
cards.reference: Emotion processing, especially fear.

cards.question: Corpus callosum?
cards.reference: Commissural fibers connecting hemispheres.

cards.question: Lateral ventricles?
cards.reference: CSF-filled cavities in cerebrum.

cards.question: Cerebellum function?
cards.reference: Coordination, balance, motor learning.

cards.question: Medulla vital centers?
cards.reference: Breathing, heart rate, blood pressure reflexes.

cards.question: Vertebral regions?
cards.reference: Cervical (7), thoracic (12), lumbar (5), sacral (5 fused), coccyx.

cards.question: Typical vertebra parts?
cards.reference: Body, vertebral arch, spinous process, transverse processes, foramen.

cards.question: Intervertebral disc?
cards.reference: Nucleus pulposus (gel) + annulus fibrosus (fibrocartilage).

cards.question: C1 (atlas) / C2 (axis)?
cards.reference: Atlas supports skull; axis has dens for rotation.

cards.question: Spinal curvatures?
cards.reference: Cervical/lumbar lordosis; thoracic/sacral kyphosis.

cards.question: Ligamentum flavum?
cards.reference: Elastic ligament between laminae — aids extension.

cards.question: Spinal nerves count?
cards.reference: 31 pairs — exit via intervertebral foramina.

cards.question: Cauda equina?
cards.reference: Lumbar/sacral nerve roots below L2 in subarachnoid space.

cards.question: Epidural space?
cards.reference: Fat and veins outside dura — site epidural anesthesia.

cards.question: Herniated disc?
cards.reference: Nucleus protrudes through annulus — may compress nerve root.

cards.question: Scoliosis?
cards.reference: Lateral curvature spine.

cards.question: Spinous process palpation?
cards.reference: Landmarks C7, T3/T7, L4 (iliac crest level).

cards.question: Facet joints?
cards.reference: Zygapophyseal — guide motion between vertebrae.

cards.question: Vertebral canal?
cards.reference: Houses spinal cord (upper) and cauda equina (lower).

cards.question: Whiplash injury?
cards.reference: Hyperextension/flexion cervical spine — soft tissue trauma.
